Question: A 19-year-old male presents to the office for evaluation after he was hit from behind below the right knee while playing football. Gait analysis reveals a lack of fluid motion. Standing flexion test results are negative. Cruciate and collateral knee ligaments appear intact. Foot drop on the right is noted. The most likely diagnosis is

Options: 
A. meniscus tear
B. tibial stress fracture
C. posterior cruciate ligament tear
D. unilateral sacral shear
E. patellar dislocation
F. medial collateral ligament sprain
G. posteriorly deviated fibular head
H. anterior cruciate ligament tear
I. plantar flexed cuboid
J. anteriorly deviated distal femur

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
